name: Immigration
headline: Corporate Immigration Support Across Africa
metaTitle: Corporate Immigration Services in Africa | Relocation Africa
metaDescription: Corporate immigration support across Africa for visas, work permits, residence, compliance, document preparation and renewals.
intro: Cross-border employment brings opportunity, and complex immigration responsibilities with it.
Relocation Africa supports corporate and multinational clients with practical, locally informed immigration coordination for employees moving into African jurisdictions.

scope.heading: Plan, Apply and Stay Compliant
scope.intro: Our immigration specialists help manage the process from early planning to application tracking, renewal management and local compliance support.

faqs.question: When should immigration planning begin?
faqs.answer: Begin as early as possible. Timelines, documentation and approvals vary by destination, role and immigration category.

faqs.question: Can Relocation Africa coordinate multi-country immigration cases?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support clients with African immigration requirements through a coordinated, location-aware approach.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee a visa or permit outcome?
faqs.answer: No provider can guarantee an authority's decision. We help clients prepare complete, accurate applications and manage the process carefully.

name: Mobility
headline: Corporate Relocation and Destination Services Across Africa
metaTitle: Corporate Relocation & Destination Services Across Africa | Relocation Africa
metaDescription: Corporate relocation and destination services across Africa, including home search, school search, settling-in and departure support.
intro: Relocation Africa helps employees and their families settle into new African destinations with clarity and confidence.
Our destination services combine local knowledge, practical coordination and personal support, helping assignees become effective in their new environment sooner.

scope.heading: Plan the Move
scope.intro: We start with a clear needs assessment, local guidance and a coordinated plan shaped around the assignee, the family and employer policy.

scope.heading: Settle In With Confidence
scope.intro: Our local teams support the practical choices that make a new destination feel manageable.

faqs.question: What does destination support include?
faqs.answer: Services are tailored to the assignee's needs and employer policy. They can include orientation, home and school search, temporary accommodation, local registrations, settling-in and departure support.

faqs.question: Can you support families as well as employees?
faqs.answer: Yes. Family needs are central to a successful assignment, and our support can include schooling, neighbourhood guidance, partner considerations and practical settling-in assistance.

faqs.question: Do you support moves within Africa and from outside Africa?
faqs.answer: We support destination services for moves into, within and out of African locations, subject to local availability and programme requirements.

name: Remuneration
headline: Remuneration Solutions for African Assignments
metaTitle: African Payroll, Expense Management & Expatriate Tax | Relocation Africa
metaDescription: Integrated African payroll, payments, expense management and expatriate tax support for multinational employers.
intro: Relocation Africa helps employers manage the financial side of international assignments with greater visibility and control.
Our remuneration services include African payroll, payments, expense management and expatriate tax support.

scope.heading: African Payroll
scope.intro: Coordinated payroll administration, reporting and payment processes designed for multi-country operations.

scope.heading: African Payments
scope.intro: Practical administration and reconciliation of relocation-related supplier and assignee payments.

scope.heading: Expense Management
scope.intro: Clearer tracking, approval and reporting of assignment-related expenses.

scope.heading: Expatriate Tax and Payroll Advisory
scope.intro: Support for assignment structuring, tax considerations and payroll compliance in partnership with relevant specialists.

faqs.question: Can you support payroll across multiple African countries?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support payroll coordination for multi-country operations. The countries in scope for your programme are confirmed during consultation.

faqs.question: Can you manage relocation-related payments?
faqs.answer: We can support the administration, tracking and reconciliation of approved relocation-related payments.

faqs.question: Do you provide legal or tax advice?
faqs.answer: Requirements depend on the assignment and jurisdiction. We coordinate with appropriate specialists and support the operational delivery of the agreed solution.

name: Research
headline: African Mobility Data for Better Decisions
metaTitle: African Cost of Living, Housing & Education Research | Relocation Africa
metaDescription: African relocation research for cost of living, housing, education and vehicle data, supporting confident mobility and remuneration decisions.
intro: Good mobility decisions depend on current, local information.
Relocation Africa provides research that helps organisations budget accurately, design workable policies and understand the practical realities employees will face in African destinations.

scope.heading: Cost of Living Analysis
scope.intro: Compare home- and host-location costs to support assignment budgeting and policy decisions.

scope.heading: Housing Surveys
scope.intro: Understand rental levels, lease practices, preferred areas and local housing considerations.

scope.heading: Education Surveys
scope.intro: Assess schooling options, curricula, availability and location factors for relocating families.

scope.heading: Vehicle and Transport Research
scope.intro: Access current information on vehicle pricing, servicing and transport conditions.

faqs.question: Can research be tailored to our policy or assignee profile?
faqs.answer: Yes. We scope research around the questions, locations and decision criteria that matter to your organisation.

faqs.question: How current is the data?
faqs.answer: African markets can shift quickly. We draw on in-country research and confirm the relevant timeframe for each assignment.

faqs.question: Who uses this research?
faqs.answer: Global HR, compensation, mobility and finance teams use it to support budgeting, policy design and employee decision-making.

name: Training
headline: Training for Confident Cross-Cultural Work
metaTitle: Cross-Cultural & Global Mobility Training in Africa | Relocation Africa
metaDescription: Cross-cultural, diversity and language training to help assignees and global teams work effectively across African markets.
intro: A successful assignment is not only about arriving in the right place. It is about helping people work, communicate and belong in a new environment.
Our training services prepare assignees, families and teams for the cultural realities of international work.

scope.heading: Cross-Cultural Preparation
scope.intro: Practical preparation for assignees and families before and after a move.

scope.heading: Diversity and Team Effectiveness
scope.intro: Workshops that help diverse teams communicate, collaborate and make the most of different perspectives.

scope.heading: Language Training
scope.intro: Flexible language support for assignees and families, shaped around their destination and needs.

scope.heading: Coaching and Reintegration
scope.intro: Support for transition, leadership and the return home after an international assignment.

faqs.question: Who is the training designed for?
faqs.answer: Assignees, their families and the teams they join. Sessions are shaped around the destination, the role and the people taking part.

faqs.question: Can training be delivered before departure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Preparation before a move helps assignees and families arrive with realistic expectations, and follow-up support can continue after arrival.

faqs.question: Can sessions be delivered remotely?
faqs.answer: Delivery is arranged to suit the participants and the assignment, including remote sessions where that works best.
